objective: Use the proven activity-only adapter as a strong H2 suppression proposal, then selectively recover only complete frozen-M20 disagreement components to regain target events and objects without undoing the false-positive reduction.

scope.fresh_outer_held_open_policy: No source array, label, target ID, prediction, component, feature, or metric may be opened before both inner groups pass and final-union checkpoints, conformal cutoff, strategy receipt, and hashes are persisted.

development_evidence_only.role: mechanism evidence only; the old checkpoint fit included G2 and is permanently forbidden as a model, feature source, calibrator, or initialization
development_evidence_only.mechanism_conclusion: Activity is a useful high-precision proposal stream, but its measurable TP/CO loss requires a separate selective recovery stage. H2 polarity mode is excluded.

rich_m20_cache.use: M20 raw score/location reference and fit-only labels/target IDs for official metrics; never a recovery feature or route

input_only_route.domain: event_count > 200000 AND complete-input polarity minority fraction >= 0.20
input_only_route.provenance: pre-existing train-only H1/H2 wide-gap rule, not selected by this experiment

stage1_activity_suppression.insertion: zero-initialized 1712-parameter residual at M20 encoder level1
stage1_activity_suppression.input: five 50-unit negative/positive pairs converted to 0.5*(negative+positive), repeated across all three 5-channel banks
stage1_activity_suppression.output_contract: persist immutable activity raw float32 scores, activity C00 float32 scores, raw/C00 SHA256, and activity component mapping; activity C00 is the proposal stream and is never tuned by Stage2

m20_component_topology.source: complete connected components of frozen M20 post-C00 positives

stage2_disagreement_domain.candidate_definition: one complete M20 component having at least one M20-positive event below threshold in the activity post-C00 output
stage2_disagreement_domain.activity_components: all complete activity post-C00 components remain; Stage2 cannot delete, attenuate, split, or rescore them
stage2_disagreement_domain.action: binary no-recovery or restore the entire original M20 component
stage2_disagreement_domain.selected_component_scores: bitwise M20 post-C00 float32 scores on every event of the selected component
stage2_disagreement_domain.partial_event_or_partial_component_actio: fail closed to exact activity identity and fail promotion

stage2_features.query: one recentered patch per occupied M20-component temporal bin; the full component sequence is retained

channel_layout.35:45: five negative/positive raw temporal frame pairs

forbidden: absolute source identity or absolute unnormalized stream time

stage2_architecture.long_track_encoder: 8-to-8 trajectory MLP plus bidirectional GRU hidden16 over the complete component sequence
stage2_architecture.pooling: learned temporal attention concatenated with valid-token maximum
stage2_architecture.output: one recovery-utility logit per complete disagreement component; never an event score

stage2_fit_label.rule: positive iff restoring this complete M20 component alone into the activity output makes the exact official source Score strictly larger than activity alone
stage2_fit_label.labels_and_target_ids: fit-only closure used to compute the binary class and marginal Score delta
stage2_fit_label.reason: This learns recovery utility only inside activity/M20 disagreement and is not the V3 all-M20 pure-FP task.

stage2_training.loss: source-and-class-balanced binary cross entropy on strict marginal recovery utility
stage2_training.sample_weight: within each source and class use inverse observed fit count, then normalize all fit weights to mean one; no manually chosen positive multiplier
fail_closed_if: any nonfinite feature, loss, probability, or gradient
any Stage1, M20, or atomic-integrity state changes outside its permitted scope

fit_only_probability_scale.raw_direction: larger means more likely beneficial to recover
fit_only_probability_scale.reference: sorted raw probabilities of that model's own fit marginal-negative disagreement components
fit_only_probability_scale.conformal_confidence: (1 + number of fit-negative probabilities strictly below the query probability) / (1 + fit-negative count)
fit_only_probability_scale.tie_policy: a tie with a fit negative gains no confidence
fit_only_probability_scale.reason: Use a model-local fit-only risk scale so the G1 and G3 cross-model logits cannot repeat V3's disjoint raw-probability calibration failure.

nested_grouped_oof.pipeline_g1: fresh Stage1 and Stage2 fit only on G1, then predicts only G3
nested_grouped_oof.pipeline_g3: fresh Stage1 and Stage2 fit only on G3, then predicts only G1
nested_grouped_oof.fit_feature_generation: each recovery head is trained on its own group's final-epoch Stage1 full-stream disagreement; generalization and all selection evidence come only from the opposite complete group
nested_grouped_oof.candidate_cutoffs: identity nextafter(max,+infinity) plus every unique G1/G3 inner-OOF conformal confidence; no numeric grid
nested_grouped_oof.exact_replay: official Score/IoU/Pd/Fa and TP/FP/CO/FC for every source, each complete group, and pooled
nested_grouped_oof.deterministic_selection: among qualifying exact breakpoints maximize minimum group Score gain, then pooled Score gain, then minimize maximum group Pd loss, then choose the higher conservative cutoff
nested_grouped_oof.no_qualifying_cutoff: stop before final-union refit and do not open G2

final_union_and_outer_held.refit: fresh Stage1 and Stage2 on union G1+G3 with unchanged architecture, loss, epochs, seed policy, and final-epoch selection
final_union_and_outer_held.cutoff: reuse the frozen inner-OOF conformal-confidence cutoff; no refit or G2 adjustment
final_union_and_outer_held.outer_held: one full-T160 paired evaluation on train_092..094
final_union_and_outer_held.failure: eliminate this frozen structure; no G1 retest, no G2 cutoff adjustment, and no validation/test run

before_fit_labels_attach: complete M20 and activity component IDs/offsets

cpu_gate.required: all pass before any GPU authorization

gpu_probe_budget.source_role: G3 fit source, never held G2
gpu_probe_budget.reason_for_two_step_budgets: both independent trainable stages must demonstrate finite loss, gradient, update, and scope; a single shared eight-step count cannot exercise Stage2 before Stage1 creates a real disagreement set
gpu_probe_budget.full_stream: one M20 and one Stage1 T160 feature pass on train_095 only
must_check: Stage1 14/14 trainable tensors get finite nonzero gradient and update
all 89 M20 tensors remain bitwise equal
real nonempty disagreement set with both marginal classes or fail without substitution
Stage2 semantic, activity/polarity, trajectory, GRU, attention, and classifier gradients are finite and nonzero
activity outside recovery is bitwise equal
selected M20 components are complete and bitwise copied
no held G2, validation, or test array read

formal_resource_budget.stage2_steps_formula: 16 * sum(ceil(disagreement_component_count_by_fit_model / 16)); counts are observed mechanics, never capped or selected
formal_resource_budget.execution: sequential model loading and feature extraction; never co-resident training jobs
